scenarioEvidence.editorialReason: Sample mistaken for sale portion; sample eaten on site, box expiry for gift two days later, four-hour transport and package labels shared. Multi-stage gift handling, not bag-price/individual-count gift template.

scenarioEvidence.title: 高速バスの停留所名が道路の反対側と同じ
scenarioEvidence.editorialReason: Same bus-stop name on opposite directions: correct Tokyo-bound side reached by official crossing without stairs, no boarding wrong side; missed service must be checked with booking contact. Actual highway-bus logistics.

scenarioEvidence.editorialReason: Inside coat coffee stain already wiped with water, no detergent; fabric protection over guaranteed removal, owner approves added work only after method/cost callback. Genuine cleaning intake and consent boundary.

scenarioEvidence.title: 携帯ショップで本人の契約と家族の端末を区別する
scenarioEvidence.editorialReason: Borrowed family handset still contains their SIM, broken own device offsite; separates handset display from own contract, no family setting changes, then discusses replacement use. No shared-account name swap.

scenarioEvidence.title: 税務署で給与以外の収入をまだ合計していない
scenarioEvidence.editorialReason: Salary paperwork excludes translation side income; separates fee/reimbursed travel in deposits, supports each expense rather than automatic deduction. Obihiro instead reconciles two employers' annual salary and reimbursements, not omitted freelance income.

scenarioEvidence.title: 乗換えで改札を二度通ったと思い係員へ履歴の確認を頼む
scenarioEvidence.editorialReason: Paper-ticket passage plus accidental IC tap prompts history lookup, no repeat gate; departure ticket/IC route and near reservation verified, friend held informed. Actual gate/media interaction rather than meeting outside barrier.

scenarioEvidence.title: お守りの見本を購入品と思って持ち帰りかける
scenarioEvidence.editorialReason: Unsealed amulet is a display sample; returns sample and receives one matching sealed gift, verifies colour/count and photo permission. Shrine counter semantics distinct from goshuin blank-page selection.

scenarioEvidence.title: 買った服を着る前に縫い目のほどけを見つける
scenarioEvidence.editorialReason: Unworn shirt seam unravels, tags/receipt and unwashed/unrepaired state supplied; same stock found, inspects exchange before completion. Specific sewn defect with completed replacement, no generic refund wait.

scenarioEvidence.editorialReason: No-enrolment public session does not include booked private carer consultation; keeps general attendance and arranges separate confidential assistance. Retains privacy skill, but appointment scope differs from two administrative bills.

scenarioEvidence.title: 祭り準備で雨の場合の案内を配る前に確認する
scenarioEvidence.editorialReason: Forecast versus organizer's decision: holds regular/rain leaflets and social post until official venue/version agree. Volunteer's authority and two publishing channels create meaningful work transition.

scenarioEvidence.title: 夜勤前に宅配の支払コードと受取コードを区別する
scenarioEvidence.editorialReason: Payment code versus collection code found; oversized parcel cannot go to night shift, employer refuses storage, tomorrow car pickup within displayed period. Both code correction and logistic refusal drive changed plan.

scenarioEvidence.title: 失くしたカードの届出を別の銀行窓口で始めかける
scenarioEvidence.editorialReason: ATM-site bank not card issuer; passbook photo reveals different issuer, consults verified official contact before urgent loss stop. This counter does not falsely say external card protected; no repeat lost-card reissue plot.

scenarioEvidence.title: 杖を持つ乗客がエスカレーターを避ける
scenarioEvidence.editorialReason: Cane user declines escalator and rushing, lets friend take earlier train and chooses arrival-station reunion after lift route. Prior intermediate boarding correction still seeks same train; here deliberately separates departures for safe pace.

scenarioEvidence.title: 書類送付の証拠として受付控えと配達記録を区別する
scenarioEvidence.editorialReason: Application sender distinguishes dispatch receipt from delivered proof and reads deadline as must-arrive; asks recipient about method and late handling before sending. No automatic postage choice or promised arrival.

scenarioEvidence.title: 銀行口座の申込みで来日目的の説明を直す
scenarioEvidence.editorialReason: Companion described travel but本人 requests salary account; recruited yet not started work, truthful records and本人 answering. Prior Hokkaido applicant already resigned and has no next employer; neither common opening skill dictates final approval.

scenarioEvidence.title: 食品の解凍品表示をそのまま生で食べられる意味と誤解する
scenarioEvidence.editorialReason: Thawed fish is not ready-to-eat; catches heating-only label, asks raw-display storage then postpones fish purchase due to two-hour outing. Prior Sandagawa chooses one no-cooking meal immediately, without transport postponement.

scenarioEvidence.title: 公園でイベント列と遊具待ちを取り違える
scenarioEvidence.editorialReason: Child queues for event believing ordinary playground; asks separate same-day availability, no slots, parent corrects own promise and chooses ordinary play. Prior stamp rally ends for fatigue/deadline, not admission scope or mistaken queue.

scenarioEvidence.title: 遅延で迎えの車の予定を変える
scenarioEvidence.editorialReason: Delay unannounced, family already driving to pickup; uses message for stopped-car review, defers route change until receiving agreement, preserves station/driver coordination. Prior wrong-line delay notice corrects service identity rather than active pickup arrangement.

scenarioEvidence.title: 相談予約の日に残業が入って欠席を連絡する
scenarioEvidence.editorialReason: Current consultation absent for overtime, next rota unknown; cancels existing slot without provisional rebooking, checks separate notice deadline before postponing. Prior medical reschedule chooses available doctor after approved leave.

scenarioEvidence.title: 会計で領収書の宛名を家族の名前に変えたいと言う
scenarioEvidence.editorialReason: Family pays patient fee, player asks family-name receipt for reimbursement; declines misidentifying受診者 and retains own-name receipt after family contacts employer. Different from whether receipt proves diagnosis or two charges sum to card total.

scenarioEvidence.title: 拾得者を名乗る人から返却前の送金を求められる
scenarioEvidence.editorialReason: Claimed earbud finder asks prepaid money, only same-model photograph not serial identity; no cash/address disclosure, asks official delivery with own purchase/box records. Goes beyond generic unknown financial demand through actual lost-property identity and restitution question.

scenarioEvidence.title: 不在通知の再配達を電話で頼む前に荷物番号を探す
scenarioEvidence.editorialReason: Missing notice, purchase order ID not tracking ID; shipping email reveals different carrier and even correspondence to missing paper unconfirmed. Corrects both identifier and responsible organisation before redelivery request.

scenarioEvidence.title: 銀行カードをなくした人がスマホの利用停止範囲を聞く
scenarioEvidence.editorialReason: Card loss stop already done, asks scope for app and rent debit instead of deleting app or presuming all payments stopped. Prior found-card script checks whether stop/reissue can be reversed and separately another issuer card.

scenarioEvidence.title: スーパーの不具合品を交換した後に同じ問題が起きる
scenarioEvidence.editorialReason: Exchange replacement bottle leaks too, gasket removed/refit uncertain; keeps empty object, instructions, use photo and one-purchase/one-exchange history for cause enquiry rather than third swap. Different from physical damaged-goods scope or mismatch of container sizes.

scenarioEvidence.title: 公園で体調の悪い同行者のため職員を呼ぶ
scenarioEvidence.editorialReason: Companion acutely unwell at named bench, responsive but unable to walk; requests park staff, stays alongside, reports observed change and monitors response rather than leaving alone or giving diagnosis. Actual care escalation, not simply choosing a slower walk.

retainedSharedSkills: Asking for clarification, correcting assumptions, keeping本人 decisions, checking supporting records, transport/accessibility coordination, safe work reporting and preserving evidence naturally recur.

Retained comparisons have specific substantive constraints and changed decisions, documented per scenario. Example: escaped dog recovery versus already-held dog waiting; forward mail earlier versus keeping mail at old address; current two patients symptoms versus a relatives past medical experience.
Bank stopping, counter inquiry and administrative referral are appropriate outcomes where staff cannot promise eligibility or results. They are not filled with a fixed final salutation.

generalOfficialReferenceChecks.topic: postal relocation/forwarding service; no numeric processing-day claim inserted
international contents declaration; specific country conditions kept pending at counter

factsAndSimulation.medicalFinancialLegalScope: Dialogue practises reporting, questions and asking relevant staff; does not diagnose, determine tax/legal entitlement, guarantee bank access or provide facility-specific advice.

limitations: AI author/editor review, not independent native-speaker certification.
Selected comparisons cannot prove absence of every possible semantic overlap across the whole corpus.
Source records and runtime authoring flags stay draft-scoped; this separate hash-bound decision is the prefecture master gate. Any later edit invalidates its corresponding reviewed hash.

recoveryReview.decision: Restored all 15 exact final source entries available in visible prior tool calls; reviewed their goal chains and closure again. Carry forward upstream semantic evidence for 94 byte-identical runtime scripts. Updated candidate retrieval agrees with prior visible comparisons for the restored scripts. AI teaching-content approval, not native-speaker or actual-facility-policy approval.
